jess (support): New ticket from AcmeCorp — their payments toolcall (payments.execute) is failing with JSON Schema validation. Errors reported: additionalProperties 'metadata' not allowed; amount: expected number but got string. Customer says it started after a mobile SDK update.

support-bot: Ticket #12345 created (severity: P2). Attachments set to logs + request payload.

jess (support): Pasting the raw request they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acme-001",
  "amount": "1000",
  "currency": "USD",
  "line_items": "[{\"sku\":\"widget\",\"qty\":1}]",
  "metadata": { "source_app": null },
  "payment_method": "card"
}
```

akshay (eng): Looks like two issues: 1) line_items has been JSON-stringified on the client (string instead of array). 2) amount is a string not a numeric type. The extra metadata object (with null) triggers additionalProperties depending on the schema (we explicitly disallow unknown top-level props).

lee (sre): Validator trace from gateway logs: 
```
ValidationError: additionalProperties [metadata] not allowed at /body
ValidationError: type mismatch at /body/amount (expected number, got string)
ValidationError: type mismatch at /body/line_items (expected array, got string)
    at jsonschema.validate (/services/gateway/validator.js:82:15)
```

akshay (eng): Repro steps I used locally:
1) curl request that reproduces the failure:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/execute \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acme-001","amount":"1000","currency":"USD","line_items":"[{\"sku\":\"widget\",\"qty\":1}]","metadata":{"source_app":null},"payment_method":"card"}'
```
2) Gateway returns 422 with the first schema error (additionalProperties).

akshay (eng): Short-term mitigation options:
- Support can ask the customer to update their mobile SDK to stop stringifying line_items and to send amount as a number. I can provide a one-line patch for their iOS/Android client.
- Deploy a gateway shim that strips unknown top-level keys (metadata) and attempts a safe coercion of numeric-looking strings to numbers for the amount field (opt-in for enterprise tenants).

akshay (eng): Proposed gateway patch (javascript):
```js
// small pre-validator shim applied per-tenant when lenientValidation = true
function normalizePayload(body){
  if(typeof body.amount === 'string' && /^\\d+(\\\\.\\\\d+)?$/.test(body.amount)){
    body.amount = Number(body.amount);
  }
  if(typeof body.line_items === 'string'){
    try{ body.line_items = JSON.parse(body.line_items); } catch(e){ /* leave as-is, let validator fail */ }
  }
  // strip known-noise keys
  delete body.metadata;
  return body;
}
```

lee (sre): If we add the shim, we should also log original/raw payload in a secure log for repro and compliance, and add an alert on increased 422 rates for payments.execute. I can add a Kibana dashboard panel.

jess (support): Action items: 
- akshay: prepare the gateway-shim PR (opt-in per-tenant); include unit tests for string-number coercion and string->array parsing.
- jess: send customer the temporary SDK fix and the suggested request shape to unblock them.
- lee: add alert on 422 spike for payments.execute and monitor after patch.

akshay (eng): One more note — we should also improve our 422 response body to include the exact JSONPath and expected type (e.g., {path: '/line_items', expected: 'array', got: 'string'}) instead of the generic additionalProperties message. That will reduce back-and-forth with customers.

jess (support): Agreed. I'll raise a docs task to update the error docs and examples. Sending customer the SDK snippet now. Will update ticket #12345 when shim PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
